resolution: Investigated the repeated [decal-bake] / [DRAGDRAW] warnings. Root cause: DecalPixelBaker is mounted at the hmsc-int shell root and auto-bakes stale custom decal docs while idle. The pixel payloads for custom:dicks/custom:claudes-closet are 52-71KB before JSON/base64 overhead, but the Zig localstore path only accepts 8KB values and the V8 host binding swallows BufferTooSmall. The warning logs before saveDecalPixels, so it claims stored even though persistence fails; the next read still sees stale decals and bakes again, causing idle frame stalls.
